svg.title: App Catalog lifecycle
svg.desc: Catalog/action projections, same-origin PhotoPrism access, PROot runtime, worker-owned lifecycle, health/media readiness, backup, restore preview, and update lifecycle.

a.xlink:title: hosts process (Local process)
same-origin request (HTTPS)
app cards and actions (HTTPS)
base-path probe (HTTP)
catalog/action projection (SQLite)
refreshes canonical readiness (Python)
updates app state (SQLite)
runs backup/update paths (Python)
records sanitized lifecycle (SQLite/NATS)
stores manifests/operations (SQLite)
same-origin /apps path (HTTP)
PhotoPrism. Provides the verified managed photo application under a same-origin Caddy path.
PROot Ubuntu application container. Hosts verified applications such as PhotoPrism without making documentation tooling or the browser a runtime dependency.
React / Vite PWA. Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.
App Catalog. Presents backend-owned app lifecycle and safe action readiness, including same-origin Open routes and Manage details.
Media readiness and app health probes. Verifies approved media mapping, base-path route health, and app readiness without scanning or exposing user media in documentation.
App, command, and workflow state. Stores canonical app current/action lifecycle and workflow command/current/event state.
Backup, restore, and checkpoint state. Stores backup manifests, recovery operations, current state, database backups/restores, and restore checkpoints.
App lifecycle worker. Owns install, repair, media import, backup, restore preview, update readiness/apply, and removal paths only where implemented and safe.
App backup, restore preview, and update lifecycle. Coordinates app backup, safe restore preview, update readiness/apply, verification, and rollback gates without browser-owned execution.
Completion and audit evidence. Records sanitized lifecycle and completion evidence for commands, devices, apps, security, recovery, and releases.
Caddy same-origin proxy. Serves the PWA and routes /api/lite/* and managed app paths without exposing backend secrets.
